Method of Attack: Exploiting SegmentSmack via a specially crafted stream of TCP segments causing resource exhaustion (increased CPU and RAM use) leading to system reboot
Exploiting FragmentSmack via a specially crafted stream of IP datagrams causing resource exhaustion (increased CPU and RAM use) leading to system reboot
Impacted Systems: Devices running Linux kernel 4.9 and later (SegmentSmack)
Devices running Linux kernel 3.9 and later (FragmentSmack)
Linux-based systems including servers, personal computers, tablets, smartphones
Major Linux distros like Debian, Red Hat, Ubuntu
ISP-grade routers, firewall providers, cloud services, hosting firms
